# Home Assistant Control

> A local-first control center for compatible Mijia devices and SunLogin smart plugs, with Windows, macOS and browser clients.

Home Assistant Control is a paid desktop application from an independent developer. It runs a control center on an always-on computer, imports compatible Mijia devices through a Xiaomi account, controls them over the local network with miIO/MIoT, and can also scan and control SunLogin smart plugs. It is not affiliated with Xiaomi, Mijia, SunLogin/Oray or the Home Assistant project.

## Product facts

- Price: $9.99 USD, one-time purchase
- License: 2 computers, 1 year of updates
- Platforms: Windows 10/11 (64-bit), macOS 13+, browser dashboard served by the app
- Activation: machine-bound offline HAC code, verified locally with an embedded ECDSA P-256 public key
- No subscription, no telemetry, no cloud relay
- Real-device control requires a paid license; a demo mode with sample data is available
- Local control works without internet; Xiaomi login/import, model spec sync and SunLogin cloud plugs need internet
- Not supported: Bluetooth/BLE Mesh/Zigbee/Matter gateways, cameras, locks, robot maps, cloud remote control of other homes
